data.gender_notes: Fuhaidah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fuhaidah refers to a woman who is the mistress of a ford, a place where a river or stream is crossed. This name carries a sense of strength and power, as a woman who controls such an essential crossing point is a vital figure in the community. The name Fuhaidah carries the meaning “Lady of the ford” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fuhaidah usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of the ford and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fuhaidah has ancient roots and is mentioned in the poems of Pre-Islamic Arab Poets and in Islamic texts. The image of a woman who manages a ford, providing safe passage for travelers and ensuring the flow of communication and trade, is a symbol of strength, wisdom, and community service. Fuhaidah is a feminine embodiment of the elemental forces of nature that can bring life and connect people.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Fuhaidah holds spiritual significance as it signifies grace, protection, and guidance. The woman at the ford provides travelers not only with physical passage but also with guidance and safety amidst the uncertain journey of life. The name calls forth the qualities of the Divine Feminine-- nurturing, protective, wise, and powerful. It reminds us of the guidance and protection given by Allah and the importance of being a source of strength and wisdom to others. The name Fuhaidah can serve as a reminder to build strong communities, support each other, and be a source of light and guidance for those in need.
